snip.t: The following is true regarding atopic dermatitis in children:
snip.s: Paediatrics end of fourth year main exam: 1 July 2019, Paper One, 99 of 100 MCQs

snip.t: –Childhood asthma is often accompanied by eczema (atopic dermatitis).
For atopic dermatitis, antihistaminic drugs such as diphenhydramine are used mostly for their sedative
The atopic triad (eczema, asthma, allergic rhinitis) with flexural distribution is classic for atopic dermatitis.
snip.s: Skin & Breast Pathology Short Answer Questions

snip.t: The majority are atopic, presenting with atopic dermatitis, allergic rhinitis, asthma, and peripheral eosinophilia.
Foods: Peanuts, tree nuts, shellfish, milk, eggs — Atopic dermatitis, asthma
POOR CONTROL of Asthma, Otitis, Anaphylaxis, Sinusitis, Atopic dermatitis
● Family History:​ Asthma, allergies, hay fever, atopic dermatitis.

qs.q: A patient with a history of atopic dermatitis is evaluated for a new skin rash. Which of the following conditions is part of the 'atopic triad' that often coexists with atopic dermatitis?
qs.e: The atopic triad consists of atopic dermatitis, asthma, and allergic rhinitis. The other options are autoimmune or cardiovascular conditions not part of this specific genetic association.
